item: The card audit no longer spends its budget on the unserved trending scan, and a bundle member keeps the deadline it was given
summary: While the keyword rollup is not serving, the six producers that call the live trending scan (named in _TRENDING_SCAN_PRODUCERS; an AST test fails when a seventh appears) are recorded as skipped-no-rollup with the reason instead of run, counted in the summary and left out of the determinism pass; the rollup state is read once per pass. The /card-audit endpoint takes budget_s in seconds and otherwise uses what is left of the enclosing statement deadline, because guarded_read opened its own 60 s deadline that replaced the bundle member's 300 s; guarded_read gained deadline_s and the report states the budget and its source. Both bundles of 2026-10-16 had every producer after rising_now read skipped-budget.
